name: dsh-dream-skin-chart-deps
description: An isolated dependency scope for the README growth-chart PNG renderer. Kept separate from the root package.json on purpose: the root project declares optional peer dependencies (e.g. @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*) that do not exist on the public npm registry, so a plain `npm ci` at the repo root fails (E404) and would silently break the daily chart job. Chart rendering needs exactly one third-party package (@resvg/resvg-js), so this tiny locked scope installs only that.
